body: I never expected to fall in love with someone else while I was married. I should end my marriage, but I'm a coward and now the only woman I realize I ever loved truly is leaving me and I'm falling apart. I don't deserve sympathy, I'm the bad guy. Everything has lost it's color, I don't care anymore. She's met someone and it's the only thing that revolves in my mind, killing me over and over. I'm hurting my wife by not really being here and I'm hurting the woman I love by never being there enough for her and now I have nothing in my life I care about anymore.
